macros.name: DeclareTotalTColorBox
macros.doc: Operates like \NewTotalTColorBox, but based on \DeclareDocumentCommand instead of \NewDocumentCommand.

macros.name: ProvideTCBox
macros.doc: Operates like \NewTCBox, but based on \ProvideDocumentCommand instead of \NewDocumentCommand.

macros.name: ProvideTotalTColorBox
macros.doc: Operates like \NewTotalTColorBox, but based on \ProvideDocumentCommand instead of \NewDocumentCommand.

macros.name: renewthetcbcounter
macros.doc: Redefines \thetcbcounter for usage inside an already existing ⟨tcolorbox⟩.

macros.name: RenewTotalTColorBox
macros.doc: Operates like \NewTotalTColorBox, but based on \RenewDocumentCommand instead of \NewDocumentCommand.

macros.name: tcbbreak
macros.doc: To force a page or column break, \tcbbreak starts a new paragraph and inserts an insane tall rule which causes a break and which is immediately discarded.

macros.name: tcbcounter
macros.doc: Real counter name of the current numbered box for possible use inside the box.

macros.name: tcbcounterof
macros.doc: Real counter name of a numbered ⟨tcolorbox⟩.

macros.name: tcbheightfromgroup
macros.doc: Saves the height from an equal height group with the given ⟨id⟩ to a ⟨macro⟩.

macros.name: tcbheightspace
macros.doc: If the height of a tcolorbox is not the natural height, the space difference between the forced and the natural size is hold by \tcbheightspace.

macros.name: tcbifoddpage
macros.doc: If the current box is on an odd page, the ⟨odd code⟩ is executed. On an even page, the ⟨even code⟩ is executed.

macros.name: tcbifoddpageoroneside
macros.doc: For onesided documents, the ⟨odd code⟩ is executed always. For twosided documents, this macro is identical to \tcbifoddpage.

macros.name: tcbinputrecords
macros.doc: Opens a file denoted by ⟨file name⟩ for reading the records via \input.

macros.name: tcblistof
macros.doc: Displays the generated list of tcolorboxes with the given ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: tcblower
macros.doc: The text content of the box can be divided in an upper and a lower part by the command \tcblower.

macros.name: tcbox
macros.doc: Creates a colored box which is fitted to the width of the given ⟨box content⟩.

macros.name: tcbpatcharcangular
macros.doc: \tcbpatcharcangular is a patch which straightens the arcs.

macros.name: tcbpatcharcround
macros.doc: This macro reverts \tcbpatcharcangular, i. e., the patch from \tcbpatcharcangular is replaced by the original code.

macros.name: tcbrecord
macros.doc: Records any ⟨content⟩ to the record file.

macros.name: tcbsetmanagedlayers
macros.doc: Replaces the highest managed layer number by ⟨number⟩ where 4 is the default.

macros.name: tcbstartrecording
macros.doc: Opens a file denoted by ⟨file name⟩ for writing the records.

macros.name: tcbstoprecording
macros.doc: Closes the current record file which was opened by \tcbstartrecording before.

macros.name: tcbsubskin
macros.doc: Creates a new skin ⟨name⟩ which inherits all properties of an existing ⟨base skin⟩ plus the given ⟨options⟩.

macros.name: tcbtextheight
macros.doc: This property describes the designated box content height.

macros.name: tcbuselibrary
macros.doc: Loads the libraries given by the ⟨key list⟩.

macros.name: tcbusetemp
macros.doc: Loads the current temporary file which was saved by tcbwritetemp.

macros.name: thetcbcounter
macros.doc: Counter value of the current numbered box.

macros.name: thetcolorboxnumber
macros.doc: This is a unique identifier (arabic number) for a tcolorbox.

macros.name: thetcolorboxpage
macros.doc: This macro contains the expanded arabic page number of the current tcolorbox.

envs.name: tcbverbatimwrite
envs.doc: Saves the ⟨environment content⟩ to a file named by ⟨file name⟩.
